title: Đêm bát hát
about: Round x10, for sleep with improvised melodies (style ngu-ngon), as the user asked to go on ("ok chúng ta hãy tiếp tục sáng tác nhạc"), on the sounds the user liked most: singing bowls in the dark, one every few breaths, a low drone, the glass improvising very slowly between them. C sharp Dorian. No drums, plucked string or organ. An original piece; its melody made up by the improviser in dark/ambient.py.
